F9 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
A genome-wide FAIL is a statement about protein IDENTITY across 95 mammals, not
about co-evolution as such and not about Evo 2, whose nucleotide representation
reads intra-genic, promoter and non-coding covariation a gene-level rate cannot.
Every dn and ds field in Compara 116 is NULL, which is what forced identity; real
ERC correlates BRANCH rates from gene trees, and that version remains untested.
OmniPath and SIGNOR edges are literature-curated and biased toward studied genes;
F3 matches ortholog count, divergence and variance but cannot match study effort.
